scope_notes: All three public gobby-feedback tools are mapped. Nine MCP mappings include six shared task/session operations; five CLI leaves and five HTTP endpoints bring total mapped operations to 19.

Task lifecycle, artifacts and discovery retain primary coverage in tasks; agent definition/persona/spawn and pipeline execution retain primary coverage in agents/pipelines. Review references link their operation guidance rather than duplicating schemas.
Review learning is owned by memory; this leaf preserves the epic-specific confirmed qa-miss/validation-miss attribution contract. There is no dedicated test-quality MCP or HTTP API.
Mutating verification uses isolated test hub fixtures and temporary reports; live reads inspect installed definitions only.
